name: singlet_trajectory_pseudotime_de
title: Pseudotime differential expression
description: Tests, for each gene, whether expression changes along pseudotime, differs between lineages or branches, or changes from lineage start to end, using negative-binomial models with FDR control. Default method is tradeseq (GAM Wald tests). Use pseudotimede when pseudotime was estimated from the same cells and calibrated p-values matter more than cost. Needs raw counts and an obs pseudotime column, plus lineage weights for lineage tests. Writes per-gene p-values, FDR and fitted curves. Do not use to infer pseudotime or to order cells.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

pseudotime.description: obs column with per-cell pseudotime, oriented from the root cell.

lineage_key.description: obsm key of cell-by-lineage weights in [0, 1]; null tests a single lineage.

test.description: association: trend along pseudotime; start_vs_end: end minus start; pattern, early_de: lineage differences; branch_beam: monocle_beam only.

method.description: tradeseq: NB GAM Wald tests; pseudotimede: estimated-pseudotime null; monocle_dgt, monocle_beam: NB likelihood-ratio tests.

alpha.description: FDR level for summary counts and calls; does not change the FDR values written.

seed.description: Seed for lineage-weight draws, subsamples and permutations.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

tradeseq.description: Options used when method is tradeseq.

nknots.description: Spline basis functions per lineage; knots sit at pseudotime quantiles.

min_cells_per_lineage.description: Cells a lineage needs before its smoother is fitted; a singlet guard, not a tradeSeq default.

pseudotimede.description: Options used when method is pseudotimede.

n_subsamples.description: Pseudotime subsamples B for the permutation null; p-values have resolution 1/(B+1).

subsample_fraction.description: Fraction of cells in each subsample.

reinference.description: Ordering method re-run on each subsample; the trajectory.pseudotime_ordering method by default.

model.description: Count model; auto chooses zinb over nb when the AIC gain exceeds aicdiff.

k.description: Spline basis dimension for each smooth.

aicdiff.description: AIC margin for choosing zinb over nb when model is auto.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. var/association_pvalue. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed fits: method, test, n_genes_tested, n_failed_fits, n_fdr_below_alpha; pseudotimede adds n_subsamples and min_attainable_pvalue.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
